headline: KCR @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 3.85 at CIN 5.39, with a projected total of 9.23. Batter research is strongest for Maikel Garcia, Vinnie Pasquantino, JJ Bleday, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler Tolbert, Matt McLain because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
